summary:
Comprehensive Plan to fix:
1. Theme text contrast across all 15 themes (specifically Minimalist Monochrome where accent is white, ensuring high-contrast readable button texts with --theme-accent-contrast).
2. Complete Canva-style docked formatting toolbar with categorized popovers above keyboard: implementing 100% of requested text styling tools (Bold, Strong, Italic, Emphasis, Underline, Strikethrough, Delete, Highlight, Mark, Superscript, Subscript, Monospace, Inline Code, Small Text, Overline, ForeColor, Fill Color, WebLink, Title, Subtitle, H1-H20, Display/Hero Text, Caption, Label, Unordered/Ordered/Task/Definition/Nested lists, Alignments, Line Height, Leading, Tracking, Word Spacing, Indents, RTL/LTR).
3. Text selection preservation so formatting tools apply reliably to selected text without losing cursor focus.
4. Normal native keyboard and clipboard behavior: removing select-none from canvas parents, enabling standard text paste, Gboard GIF support, and native cursor/magnifier behavior.
5. GitHub Actions Android APK build workflow (build-apk.yml) & native full-screen fix: preventing rm -rf android from wiping native MainActivity/styles modifications, configuring edge-to-edge WindowCompat, translucent status bar, and Capacitor keyboard/status bar settings.
